content.comment_body: Hi, I need to read an analog input and then activate a relay output in BCD (binary-coded decimal) format. Is there a straightforward solution to this? Thanks for your assistance.
Hello, Please refer to the [product_name] application examples in the documentation, under Other Applications > Decimal - BCD converter. Regards,
Hello [user_name], please provide more detailed information so we can offer a solution based on your specific requirements.

Hi, I need to manage a small solar power plant. The measurement device constantly tracks the power consumed and sends this as a 4-20mA proportional signal to the [product_name]. The PLC processes this input by converting it to binary format and manages the power plant through output relays. Apologies for my English. Regards

Hello [user_name], I'm trying to understand your objective more clearly. How precise do you want your coding to be? For example, you could use logic to give you binary states of 2, 4, 8, 16, and so on. The resource linked above provides different solutions depending on the number of states required. For instance, if your signal range is 0 to 10V, you could set up a circuit that encodes 0-5V as "0" and 6-10V as "1". Alternatively, you could make 0-1V equal "0", 1-2V as "1", and so on up to 9-10V as "9". You can even encode decimal values if needed. The finer the coding you require, the more blocks you'll need to set up.
